name: fx
description: fx@1, the first-party pack of named operators (canvas primitives: Pack: fx@1 named operators): composed pass graphs from the public steps only, each with its params, its cost and its grow, under the full operator check. Every operator reads and writes premultiplied color, measures its positions in its group's bounds and takes its px at design size.

fx.levels@1.about: Levels: each of rgb through the monotone cubic from (in_black, out_black) to (in_white, out_white), the line between them, held at its ends past either; alpha kept. The four are fixed when the pass is checked.

fx.curves@1.about: Curves: each of rgb through the monotone cubic over points, 2 to 16 of [in, out] with in rising, held at its ends past either; alpha kept. The points are fixed when the pass is checked.

fx.brightness_contrast@1.about: Brightness and contrast: rgb scaled about middle grey by contrast, then lifted by brightness; alpha kept.

fx.exposure@1.about: Exposure: the color's rgb times 2 to the power of stops; alpha kept.

fx.gamma_pedestal_gain@1.about: Gamma, pedestal and gain: rgb to the power 1 / gamma, times gain, plus pedestal; alpha kept.

fx.channel_mixer@1.about: Channel mixer: each output channel a weighted sum of the color's rgb and one, by a column-major matrix; alpha kept.

fx.black_white@1.about: Black and white: grey from the channels by their weights; alpha kept.

fx.tint@1.about: Tint: black mapped to one color and white to another by luminance, mixed in by amount; alpha kept.

fx.tritone@1.about: Tritone: shadows, midtones and highlights each mapped to a color by luminance, mixed in by amount; alpha kept.

fx.gradient_map@1.about: Gradient map: luminance, biased so midpoint lands halfway, mapped along a gradient from one color to another, mixed in by amount; alpha kept.

fx.selective_color@1.about: Selective color: colors whose hue lies within width of hue are turned by hue_shift, their saturation scaled and their lightness lifted, fading out at the range's edge; alpha kept.

fx.vibrance@1.about: Vibrance: saturation raised most where the color is least saturated; alpha kept.

fx.invert@1.about: Invert: rgb to one less itself, mixed in by amount; alpha kept.

fx.leave_color@1.about: Leave color: every color but those within tolerance of color drained to grey by amount, the edge softened over softness; alpha kept.

fx.directional_blur@1.about: Directional blur: the mean of taps samples along direction, a share of the group's bounds, centred on the pixel.

fx.radial_blur@1.about: Radial blur: the mean of taps samples from the pixel toward center, as far as amount of the way.

fx.channel_blur@1.about: Channel blur: red, green and blue each the mean of 8 samples along angle, each over its own radius; alpha the widest channel's.

fx.bilateral_blur@1.about: Bilateral blur: a 5 by 5 Gaussian over radius whose taps count less the further their color is from the pixel's, so edges past threshold stay.

fx.compound_blur@1.about: Compound blur: the mean of 16 samples on a spiral whose radius is radius times the pixel's own luminance, so bright areas blur most.

fx.sharpen@1.about: Sharpen: the pixel pushed away from the mean of its four neighbours by amount, held between nothing and its alpha.

fx.unsharp@1.about: Unsharp mask: the pixel pushed away from the mean of 16 samples within radius by amount, where they differ by more than threshold.

fx.bulge@1.about: Bulge: the picture within radius of center swelled by amount, or pinched below zero, fading to none at the radius.

fx.twirl@1.about: Twirl: the picture turned about center by angle, fading to none at radius, a share of the group's bounds.

fx.ripple@1.about: Ripple: rings about center that push the picture out and in by amplitude, one ring every wavelength.

fx.wave_warp@1.about: Wave warp: a wave travelling along angle that slides the picture across it by amplitude, one wave every wavelength.

fx.polar@1.about: Polar: the picture read by angle and distance about center instead of across and down, mixed in by amount.

fx.spherize@1.about: Spherize: the picture within radius of center wrapped over a sphere by amount.

fx.mirror@1.about: Mirror: the picture on one side of the line through center at angle laid over the other, turned over.

fx.offset@1.about: Offset: the picture slid by shift within the group's bounds, what leaves one edge coming back at the other.

fx.corner_pin@1.about: Corner pin: the picture's four corners moved to quad's, top left, top right, bottom right and bottom left as shares of the group's bounds, and everything between by the homography they fix.

fx.displacement_map@1.about: Displacement map: each pixel read from as far left or right as its own red is from half, and up or down as its green is, in px, less where it covers less; between texels it weighs the four around.

fx.turbulent_displace@1.about: Turbulent displace: the picture pushed about by seeded noise of size, as far as amount; evolution moves through the noise.

fx.lens_distort@1.about: Lens distortion: the picture pushed out from center by amount times the squared distance, as a share of the half diagonal; below zero it pulls in.

fx.magnify@1.about: Magnify: the picture within radius of center enlarged by magnification, the lens's edge softened over feather.

fx.bend@1.about: Bend: the picture bowed across angle by amount at its middle, its two ends held.

fx.page_turn@1.about: Page turn: the picture folded back along a line that crosses it toward angle as progress goes from 0 to 1, the folded part shown turned over and dimmed by shade, and nothing past the fold.

fx.find_edges@1.about: Find edges: the luminance gradient's magnitude from the four neighbours, times amount; alpha kept.

fx.emboss@1.about: Emboss: middle grey lifted or lowered by how much brighter the picture is height further along angle than behind, times amount; alpha kept.

fx.mosaic@1.about: Mosaic: the group's bounds as cells across and down, each the color at its centre.

fx.posterize@1.about: Posterize: each of rgb rounded to one of levels steps; alpha kept.

fx.threshold@1.about: Threshold: white where luminance is above level, black elsewhere; alpha kept.

fx.scatter@1.about: Scatter: each pixel read from a seeded place within amount of it, a whole number of px away.

fx.roughen_edges@1.about: Roughen edges: coverage eaten back to the coverage found as far as border away, in a direction seeded noise of scale gives, with nothing past the group's bounds, so an edge frays within border of where it was.

fx.motion_tile@1.about: Motion tile: the group's bounds filled with tiles copies of the picture across and down about center, slid sideways by phase.

fx.kaleida@1.about: Kaleida: the picture about center folded into segments wedges, each the mirror of the next.

fx.glass@1.about: Glass: each pixel read from where its own luminance's slope points, taken across softness to either side, amount px for a slope of one.

fx.cartoon@1.about: Cartoon: the picture smoothed over its 3 by 3 neighbours, its rgb rounded to levels steps, and inked dark where the luminance slope passes threshold, as hard as edge; alpha kept.

fx.four_color_gradient@1.about: Four-color gradient: four colors, each at its point in the group's bounds, mixed at every pixel by its distance to each to the power blend, laid over the picture by opacity.

fx.cell_pattern@1.about: Cell pattern: seeded cells of size, each pixel as bright as it is far from its cell's point times contrast, laid over the picture by opacity.

fx.checkerboard@1.about: Checkerboard: squares across the group's bounds in two colors, laid over the picture by opacity.

fx.light_rays@1.about: Light rays: what is brighter than threshold streaked away from center over reach of the distance, tinted by color and added by intensity.

fx.light_sweep@1.about: Light sweep: a band of light width wide through center, across angle, added to the picture where it has coverage, by intensity.

fx.light_burst@1.about: Light burst: the picture streaked away from center over reach of the distance and added to itself by intensity.

fx.noise@1.about: Noise: seeded per-pixel noise of amount added to rgb, keyed by the pixel's place in the group's bounds and the item's seed; alpha kept.

fx.dust_scratches@1.about: Dust and scratches: a pixel whose luminance is further than threshold from the mean of its 8 neighbours radius away, in whole px, takes that mean.

fx.set_channels@1.about: Set channels: red, green, blue and alpha each taken from a channel of the color: 0 red, 1 green, 2 blue, 3 alpha, 4 luminance, 5 full on, 6 off. A texel with no coverage stays empty.

fx.arithmetic@1.about: Arithmetic: value combined with rgb by mode: 0 add, 1 subtract, 2 multiply, 3 difference, 4 min, 5 max, 6 screen; alpha kept.

fx.minimax@1.about: Minimax: each channel the least, or with mode 1 the greatest, of its 5 by 5 neighbours.

fx.linear_color_key@1.about: Linear color key: coverage dropped where the color is within tolerance of key, back to full over softness; what is keyed out is left empty.

fx.color_difference_key@1.about: Color difference key: coverage from how far the screen's channel (0 green, 1 blue) stands above the mean of the other two, times gain, clipped between clip_black and clip_white; what is keyed out is left empty.

fx.luma_key@1.about: Luma key: the color kept where its luminance is above threshold, softened over softness, as premultiplied coverage.

fx.spill_suppressor@1.about: Spill suppressor: the screen's channel (0 green, 1 blue) pulled down toward the mean of the other two by amount; alpha kept.

fx.key_light@1.about: Key light: coverage dropped by how far the color leans to color's channels over the others, times gain, and that lean taken out of what is kept by despill; what is keyed out is left empty.

fx.choker@1.about: Choker: coverage redrawn from the mean coverage within radius, its edge moved in by choke, or out below zero, and softened over softness.

fx.gradient_wipe@1.about: Gradient wipe: the picture taken away along angle across the group's bounds as progress goes from 0 to 1, its edge softened over feather.

fx.radial_wipe@1.about: Radial wipe: the picture shown where the angle about center is past progress, its edge feathered.

fx.block_dissolve@1.about: Block dissolve: the picture taken away block by block in a seeded order as progress goes from 0 to 1, each block fading over feather.

fx.venetian_blinds@1.about: Venetian blinds: the picture taken away in strips of width across angle, each strip closing as progress goes from 0 to 1, its edge softened over feather.

fx.light_wipe@1.about: Light wipe: the picture taken away along angle as progress goes from 0 to 1, with a band of light of color on the edge, feather wide, added by intensity.

fx.slice_shift@1.about: Slice shift: horizontal strips of the picture, from count's least to its most of them, each a height in its range and moved sideways by a shift in its range, to either side, in whole px; each keeps to its own band of the height, so none meets another. They are drawn anew only at each step of time, from the seed and the step's index, never from playback.
